# The Coffee Break App — Full Reference

> Caffeine tracker and smart break scheduler. Drink smarter, sleep better — using real pharmacokinetic science.

The Coffee Break App is a mobile app for iOS and Android that tracks caffeine intake in real time and auto-schedules coffee breaks at scientifically optimal moments. It uses the standard pharmacokinetic model (5-hour half-life) to simulate caffeine decay in your bloodstream — updated live, every second — and helps you stay in the focus zone without disrupting sleep.

**Website:** https://pcristo.dev/coffe_break_website/

---

## How It Works

### 1. Tell it your habits
Set your active weekdays, how many coffees you drink per day, your preferred coffee type, and your start/end times. Takes about 60 seconds.

### 2. Get notified at the right time
The app calculates optimal break windows based on real caffeine half-life science and sends a notification when it's time — not too early, not too late.

### 3. Enjoy the break
Open the app, tap Start Break, and a calming timer takes over. A gentle bell sound marks the start and end so you return to work fuelled, focused, and on schedule.

---

## Features

### Live Caffeine Curve
A dynamic real-time graph shows your current caffeine level, ticking down second by second. Clearly marks the focus zone, plateau, and sleep-safe window.

### Smart Break Scheduling
Auto-schedules your next cup based on your current caffeine curve and the time you need to reach the focus zone. Sends a push notification at the perfect moment.

### Guided Break Timer
A focused break screen with ambient sounds (start and end) counts down your brew time. Keeps you present and refreshed before heading back to work.

### Coffee Type Profiles
Each type has a scientifically accurate caffeine profile:
- Espresso: ~63 mg
- Brewed coffee: ~95 mg
- Cold brew: ~175 mg
- Decaf: ~3 mg

### Jitter & Sleep Alerts
- Warns when you're approaching jitter territory (too much caffeine)
- Shows projected sleep clearance time — know before you drink if the afternoon cup is worth it

### Fully Configurable Schedule
- Choose active weekdays
- Set coffees per day and preferred type
- Set break duration
- Set reminder lead time

---

## The Science

Caffeine follows a pharmacokinetic decay curve with approximately a 5-hour half-life. The app models this continuously:

| Zone | Caffeine Level | Description |
|------|---------------|-------------|
| Focus zone | >220 mg | Peak alertness and cognition |
| Winding down | 20–220 mg | Declining — consider next cup or let it fade |
| Sleep-safe | <20 mg | Safe to sleep without disruption |
